#include "seidel-2d.h"

void kernel_seidel_2d(double A[40][40]) {
    const int n = 40;
    const int tsteps = 20;

    for (int t = 0; t < tsteps; t++) {
        for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < n - 1; j++) {
                double sum = A[i-1][j-1] + A[i-1][j] + A[i-1][j+1]
                           + A[i][j-1] + A[i][j] + A[i][j+1]
                           + A[i+1][j-1] + A[i+1][j] + A[i+1][j+1];
                A[i][j] = sum / 9.0;
            }
        }
    }
}
